observation.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=strassennamen&username=user1&password=user1pass" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && echo "Token obtained: ${TOKEN:0:30}..." && echo "=== Token roles ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=strassennamen&username=user1&password=user1pass" | python3 -c "import sys,json; t=json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token']; import base64; p=t.split('.')[1]; p+='='*(-len(p)%4); d=json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p)); print('resource_access:', json.dumps(d.get('resource_access',{}).get('strassennamen',{})))" && echo "=== API with token ===" && curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse"
